knownGapsByPage: Actual local scanner and app-server source/parent normalization, inventory completeness, descendant deletion and persistence remain assigned interfaces.
Version/host capability, concurrent writes, atomicity and real device byte/storage effects require owned integration.
Security queries, auth/MFA/passkey/order/history/PIN-reset providers, grant/connector services and effective security consumers remain assigned interfaces.
Empty PIN reset-return effects, actual product/shared consumers, identity changes and durable service effects remain explicit integration gaps.
Personal access and family queries, invitation/member/removal managers and notification services remain assigned interfaces.
Actual family role authorization, incoming/outgoing invitation effects, graduation notice service and mode/shared consumers remain unverified.

modeDecision.reason: Storage uses chatGptOrCodex; security/family use chatGpt access. Shared access is not a mode label, and the Security device-code control explicitly names Codex. No entire page is excluded.

keepFirstParty: family role routing and notice dismissal
dependencyBoundary.versionAuthority: Existing dependency-import/embedded inventories; no versions inferred from aliases.

moduleDecisions.decision: Separate local measurement, complete descendant inventory and reviewed cleanup; reuse archive/worktree owners with host context.
Separate credentials, protection, sessions/trust, grants and PIN state machines. Retain device-code policy as an explicit Codex/shared consumer.
Separate role/identity orchestration, delegated invitations/member management and notice-only dismissal; reuse account notifications.
